controls: A is the original Phase 2 temporal renderer. B is the frozen previous depth-projection candidate. C uses A as fallback, a learned readout of the shared stem, predicted depth and predicted source semantic probabilities. All images are 256x128.
selection: Fit one 3x3 ridge readout of source RGB on train-town camera features. Freeze the readout and all mixing parameters before evaluating C. Towns 40 and 41 are previously viewed validation towns.
gate: For each chase run on towns 40 and 41, require the original silhouette, static flicker and vacated-surface conditions versus A, plus improved whole-frame SSIM, aligned-edge contrast and RGB L1 versus A. A validation pass releases the previously reserved four fresh 320-tick drives.
media: Show full frames at the predetermined midpoint of each town and the complete chase videos at 10 Hz. Include sky and unobserved surfaces in full-frame scores.
